niche.habitat: Coastal shallows, sea-arch surges, and tidal flats (0–15 m depth)
niche.diet: Dissolved proteins, plankton, floating carcass fragments
niche.active: Nocturnal and crepuscular; rests in rock crevices during midday convection storms

body: Translucent gelatinous bell, 0.8 m diameter, four thick oral arms trailing beneath

skill.effect: Surges forward 15m along a straight arc, ignoring terrain drag

journal.en: It does not face the current; the current faces it.

secrets: Ink Jet: Absorbs volcanic ash during cave collapses to create a thick, conductive smoke screen.
Albino Variant: Lacks pore pigment, glows brighter under moonlight, grants +20% befriending at night.
moments: When the spring tide recedes, the Cuarteta collapses into a gelatinous knot on the wet rock, arms folded like a closed flower. For an hour, it is nearly stone, waiting for the water to remember it.

journal.en: It does not hunt; it waits for the world to swim into it.
The bell remembers every strike, every storm, every drifting bone.
